• High blood pressure – “Having untreated high blood pressure”【2†source】 | | **Thoracic aortic aneurysm** | • High blood pressure – “High blood pressure … raises the risk of an aneurysm”【3†source】 | Thus, **smoking (tobacco use)** and **high blood pressure (hypertension)** are identified by Mayo Clinic as common risk factors for all three types of aneurysms. (Age and family history are mentioned for each, but the question asks specifically for shared risk factors; smoking and hypertension are the shared, modifiable ones mentioned across all three conditions.)
